name: generalization capability
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 代理模型对训练条件之外输入保持预测能力的性质。

complete_examples.text: Its extended model is also implemented to predict the response of systems induced by any measured track irregu larity in real-time, which promotes the generalization capability of the proposed surrogate model.

To overcome the prediction problem of response excited by measured irregularities, some measured track irregularities are added to the training dataset (100 responses under simulated track irregularity and 100 responses under measured track irregularity that was randomly selected, besides, the sample spacing for the dynamics calculations was doubled compared to the previous anal ysis in order to address the computational memory problem), to improve the generalization capability of the proposed surrogate model.
